verdict.rationale: Brex sends real-time webhooks on account events and offers documented Zapier and Pipedream integrations, so users can build event-triggered actions such as monthly-resetting stipend cards. Natively it offers rule-like automation: auto-enforced budget controls, per-transaction limits with procurement approval flows, and automated GL coding. However, general event→action automation relies on external tools and coding rather than a native rule builder. Missing for 10: a native user-defined event-trigger/action rule engine, documented rule configuration depth (conditions, action types), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
